svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: A photo of an RTX 4090 graphics card's circuit board with five parts marked A to E, one for each row of my tech stack. A, Languages (GPU): C++, C, Rust, Python, TypeScript, Swift. B, Embedded (power input): ESP32, FreeRTOS, PlatformIO, Raspberry Pi. C, Systems (memory): Linux, NixOS, bubblewrap, dinit, Docker. D, Networks (PCIe connector): ROS 2, CycloneDDS, BATMAN-adv, UDP. E, Apps (display outputs): Svelte, Tone.js, Cloudflare, Tauri.
